ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERNAME_CCD] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName
AS(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId,CustomerNameId ORDER BY InsertDttm DESC ) RN, * FROM (
--(1)CONCAT
SELECT
BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BCM.CUST_FIRST_NAME, BCM.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME, BCM.CUST_LAST_NAME)) AS CustomerNameId
,NULL AS NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCM.CUST_DATE_MAINT)) AS StartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm

FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
WHERE BCM.ISLATEST = '1'

UNION

SELECT
BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BCD.CUST_FIRST_NAME, BCD.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME, BCD.CUST_LAST_NAME)) AS CustomerNameId
,NULL AS NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT)) AS StartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = '1'

UNION
--(2) ENGLISH NAME
SELECT
BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5',BCM.CUST_ENG_NAME) AS CustomerNameId
,'ENGLISH NAME' AS NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCM.CUST_DATE_MAINT)) AS StartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
 WHERE BCM.ISLATEST = '1'

UNION

SELECT
BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5',BCD.CUST_ENG_NAME) AS CustomerNameId
,'ENGLISH NAME' AS NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT)) AS StartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = '1'
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName WHERE RN = 1;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	CONVERT(BIGINT,CustomerId)
	,CONVERT(VARBINARY, CustomerNameId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, NameUsageId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CustomerNameNote)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, FinancialInstitutionId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, SourceSystemCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CustomerNameId ,NameUsageId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	CONVERT(BIGINT,CustomerId)
	,CONVERT(VARBINARY, CustomerNameId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, NameUsageId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CustomerNameNote)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, FinancialInstitutionId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, SourceSystemCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CustomerNameId ,NameUsageId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerName WHERE EndDate= '9999-12-31' AND SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId, TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerNameId, TGT.CustomerNameId) AS CustomerNameId
,ISNULL(SRC.NameUsageId, TGT.NameUsageId) AS NameUsageId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode, TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
	WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_TGT TGT
ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.CustomerId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,TGT.CustomerId)
AND SRC.CustomerNameId = TGT.CustomerNameId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM

UPDATE TGT
SET
EndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.StartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerName TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA DELTA
ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,DELTA.CustomerId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,TGT.CustomerId)
AND DELTA.CustomerNameId = TGT.CustomerNameId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName SRC
ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.CustomerId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,TGT.CustomerId)
AND SRC.CustomerNameId = TGT.CustomerNameId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.EndDate = '9999-12-31'




--INSERT RECCORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerName
(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameUsageId
,StartDate
,EndDate
,CustomerNameNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerId
,SRC.CustomerNameId
,SRC.NameUsageId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,StartDate))
,'9999-12-31' AS EndDate
,SRC.CustomerNameNote
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA DELTA 
ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,DELTA.CustomerId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.CustomerId)
     AND DELTA.CustomerNameId = SRC.CustomerNameId
	 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
     AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA;

END
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERNAME_SEC] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName
AS
(
SELECT
BST.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
,HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(BST.FNAME, BST.MNAME,BST.LNAME)) AS CustomerNameId
,NULL AS NameUsageId
,BST.DATE_CREATED AS StartDate
,BST.LASTUPDATED AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,'SEC' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
,BST.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST
WHERE CLTTYPE = 'I'
 AND BST.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_SRC
AS
(
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
	CONVERT(BIGINT, CustomerId)
	,CONVERT(VARBINARY, CustomerNameId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, NameUsageId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CustomerNameNote)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, FinancialInstitutionId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, SourceSystemCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CustomerNameId ,NameUsageId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_TGT
AS(
SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
	CONVERT(BIGINT, CustomerId)
	,CONVERT(VARBINARY, CustomerNameId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, NameUsageId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CustomerNameNote)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, FinancialInstitutionId)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR, SourceSystemCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CustomerNameId ,NameUsageId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerName WHERE EndDate = '9999-12-31' AND SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId, TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerNameId, TGT.CustomerNameId) AS CustomerNameId
,ISNULL(SRC.NameUsageId, TGT.NameUsageId) AS NameUsageId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode, TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.CustomerNameId = TGT.CustomerNameId
AND SRC.NameUsageId = TGT.NameUsageId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM

UPDATE TGT
SET
EndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.StartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerName TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA DELTA
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND DELTA.CustomerNameId = TGT.CustomerNameId
AND DELTA.NameUsageId = TGT.NameUsageId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName SRC
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.CustomerNameId = TGT.CustomerNameId
AND SRC.NameUsageId = TGT.NameUsageId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.EndDate = '9999-12-31'




--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerName
(
CustomerId
,CustomerNameId
,NameUsageId
,StartDate
,EndDate
,CustomerNameNote
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.CustomerNameId AS CustomerNameId
,SRC.NameUsageId AS NameUsageId
,SRC.StartDate AS StartDate
,SRC.EndDate AS EndDate
,NULL AS CustomerNameNote
,'SEC' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,SRC.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
     AND DELTA.CustomerNameId = SRC.CustomerNameId
	 AND DELTA.NameUsageId = SRC.NameUsageId
	 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
     AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerName_DELTA;

END
GO
